The `.gitattributes` file in the `python-backend` codebase specifies automatic text normalization and enforces LF line endings for shell scripts.

# Purpose
This file is a `.gitattributes` configuration file used in a Git repository. It specifies that all text files should have automatic line ending normalization (`text=auto`), and it enforces Unix-style line endings (`eol=lf`) for shell script files (`*.sh`).
